Name: DungeonMasterXIV
Author: ruminabottle
Punchline: Dice, initiative and HP for tabletop RP sessions, tracked in game.
Description: A tracker for groups running tabletop-style RP campaigns inside FFXIV. Captures rolls so they stop scrolling away, keeps turn order on every participant's screen, and tracks combatant HP and status for the current encounter. A DM hosts the session and their client is the single source of truth; players join with a session code and are admitted individually. The plugin observes and displays only — it never sends anything into the game.
